Thus the majority of these tribal womenfolk endured with carrying out political agendas
principally meant for betterment of the tribal women, are not able contribute
meaningfully towards the very basic reason of election to these posts. In majority of
cases, they still remain just a means of exploitation by the political parties whereby their
election to political positions are just a face. Upon their election into these importance
decision making political bodies, they are not able to assert their political wherewithal in
a positive manner. Thereby rendering the men-folk, be it their husband or father, to
undertake and enjoy the privilege of political power.
